title: Weymouth New Testament in Modern Speech, Titus
summary: "Weymouth New Testament in Modern Speech, Titus" by Richard Francis Weymouth is a biblical translation published in 1903. Weymouth reimagined how the New Testament's inspired writers would have expressed events if writing in nineteenth-century English. Based on his compilation of major Greek texts, this translation aimed to provide a succinct commentary alongside traditional versions. Prepared after Weymouth's death by his secretary Ernest Hampden-Cook, it offered readers a fresh, accessible rendering of scripture in contemporary language.
